title: To field
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：to　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 to 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the grower kept the crate ① to the end of the week at the shelf, and everybody in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning: the crate had been left ② to the far side of the field, and nobody had asked a single question. The grower had come to the greenhouse two summers earlier and spoke little of the greenhouse he had left behind him.

The ledger for August 1969 puts it plainer. It was done ③ to the sound of the bell, and the buyer who kept the crate had tied it ④ to the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the greenhouse was ever done to the sound of the bell in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every summer thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ to the want of a nail, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ to the children of the house; he was not a man who explained himself, and the greenhouse had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the crate be tied ⑦ to the measure of an inch, and that the names be written ⑧ to the edge of the page. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried to the measure of an inch.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985 she kept the crate ⑨ to the end of the week again when nobody else would, and ⑩ to the far side of the field, she said in 1987, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the crate in the same shelf for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the greenhouse never forgot what had been done to the far side of the field.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 向（表时间：to the end of the week）
B. prep. 向（表处所：to the far side of the field）
C. prep. 到（表方式／状态：to the sound of the bell）
D. prep. 到（引出施动者或相关的人：be tied to the hands of the doctor）
E. prep. 向（表原因：to the want of a nail）
F. prep. 到（表对象／目的：to the children of the house）
G. prep. 向（表工具／材料：to the measure of an inch）
H. prep. 到（表载体／处所：written to the edge of the page）

items.q: to the end of the week
to the far side of the field
to the sound of the bell
to the hands of the doctor
to the want of a nail
to the children of the house
to the measure of an inch
to the edge of the page
to the end of the week again
to the far side of the field, she said

answers.why: to 意为“向”，此处引出时间 the end of the week（周末），说明那件浅浅的木箱是在何时留下的。
to 意为“向”，此处引出处所 the far side of the field（田的那头），说明东西被放在何处。
to 意为“到”，此处引出方式或状态 the sound of the bell（随着钟声），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
to 意为“到”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 大夫的手里：be tied to the hands of the doctor。
to 意为“向”，此处引出原因 the want of a nail（因为缺钉子），说明整件事由何而起。
to 意为“到”，此处引出对象或目的 the children of the house（家里的孩子们）。
to 意为“向”，此处引出工具或材料 the measure of an inch（一寸的量）。
to 意为“到”，此处引出载体 the edge of the page（页边处）：names written to the edge of the page。
to 意为“向”，1985 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件浅浅的木箱，此处仍引出时间 the end of the week。
to 意为“向”，母亲 1987 年那句话引出的仍是那一处田的那头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年周末前后，种植户把那件浅浅的木箱留在了架位。（to the end of the week）
那件浅浅的木箱被放在田的那头，谁也没有过问。（to the far side of the field）
整件事是随着钟声做成的，收成账上写得明白。（to the sound of the bell）
入冬之前，那件浅浅的木箱已经由大夫的手里捆过两回。（be tied to the hands of the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为缺钉子起的。（to the want of a nail）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的孩子们做过这件事。（to the children of the house）
answers: In 1975 the grower kept the crate to the end of the week at the shelf.
The crate had been left to the far side of the field, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done to the sound of the bell, or so the ledger says.
The crate had been tied to the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun to the want of a nail.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it to the children of the house.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 to 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the grower kept the crate to the end of the week, and nobody forgot it.
The crate had been left to the far side of the field for three summers.
The work was done to the sound of the bell, as it always was in those days.
The crate had been tied to the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the crate to the end of the week again when nobody else would.
The whole greenhouse never forgot what had been done to the far side of the field.
